description: Fetch complete details for a specific CielStay listing: full description, all photos, amenities, house rules, exact location, and every booking link including the host's own direct booking site. Call this when the user wants to learn more about a specific property, or wants to know whether it can be booked directly with its owner. If the user has dates, pass checkIn and checkOut: where the host uses a supported booking engine, the response includes liveQuote, the total the guest would pay on the host's own site (room, fees and taxes), read live. Only ask for it when the user is considering those dates. Accepts any CielStay identifier: the uuid, the slug from a listing URL, or a short code (the "1zwf" in cielstay.com/l/1zwf).

checkIn.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. With checkOut, returns the live total from the host's own booking site.

guests.description: Number of guests, for the live quote. Defaults to 2.

id.description: The listing ID from a previous search result (result.id).

name: get_listing_details
